rows.name: Disable Metrics Reporting
rows.full: Stops Brave from sending anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to Brave's servers.
rows.short: Stops Brave from sending anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to Brave's servers.

rows.name: Disable Safe Browsing Reporting
rows.full: Stops extended Safe Browsing reports (details about suspicious pages and downloads) from being sent to Google. Safe Browsing protection itself stays on.
rows.short: Stops extended Safe Browsing reports (details about suspicious pages and downloads) from being sent to Google

rows.name: Disable URL Data Collection
rows.full: Stops URL-keyed anonymized data collection, which reports the URLs you visit to improve suggestion and safety features.
rows.short: Stops URL-keyed anonymized data collection, which reports the URLs you visit to improve suggestion and safety features.

rows.name: Disable P3A Analytics
rows.full: Disables P3A (Privacy-Preserving Product Analytics), Brave's anonymized product usage telemetry.
rows.short: Disables P3A (Privacy-Preserving Product Analytics), Brave's anonymized product usage telemetry.

rows.name: Disable Stats Ping
rows.full: Stops the daily usage ping that counts this install in Brave's active-user statistics.
rows.short: Stops the daily usage ping that counts this install in Brave's active-user statistics.

rows.name: Limit Variations to Critical Fixes
rows.full: Restricts Brave's remote experiment seed (Griffin) to critical security and stability fixes, instead of the full set of A/B experiments. The safe choice of the two. Mutually exclusive with Disable Variations.
rows.short: Restricts Brave's remote experiment seed (Griffin) to critical security and stability fixes, instead of the full set of A/B experiments

rows.name: Disable Variations / Griffin Experiments
rows.full: Blocks the remote experiment seed entirely, so Brave can no longer flip features in your installed browser from its servers. This also blocks the emergency killswitches Brave uses to turn off a broken or unsafe feature - pick Limit Variations to Critical Fixes unless you accept that. Mutually exclusive with Limit Variations to Critical Fixes.
rows.short: Blocks the remote experiment seed entirely, so Brave can no longer flip features in your installed browser from its servers

rows.name: Disable Enhanced Spell Check
rows.full: Stops enhanced spell check, which sends the text you type in web forms to Google's servers to be checked. Offline spell checking keeps working. Mutually exclusive with Disable Spellcheck, which turns spell checking off altogether and makes this row do nothing.
rows.short: Stops enhanced spell check, which sends the text you type in web forms to Google's servers to be checked

rows.name: Disable Safe Browsing (security downgrade)
rows.full: Turns Safe Browsing fully off. Brave already routes these lookups through its own servers, so Google never sees the sites you visit even with Safe Browsing on - turning it off buys almost no privacy and costs you the phishing and malware warning pages. Excluded from every preset for that reason.
rows.short: Turns Safe Browsing fully off

rows.name: Disable Autofill (Addresses)
rows.full: Stops Brave from saving and auto-filling street addresses in web forms.
rows.short: Stops Brave from saving and auto-filling street addresses in web forms.

rows.name: Disable Autofill (Credit Cards)
rows.full: Stops Brave from saving and auto-filling credit card numbers in web forms.
rows.short: Stops Brave from saving and auto-filling credit card numbers in web forms.

rows.name: Disable Password Manager
rows.full: Disables the built-in password manager (no save prompts, no autofill). Recommended if you use a dedicated password manager.
rows.short: Disables the built-in password manager (no save prompts, no autofill)

rows.name: Disable Password Leak Detection
rows.full: Stops the online check that compares your saved credentials against known breach lists. Defense in depth if you audit passwords with your own manager instead.
rows.short: Stops the online check that compares your saved credentials against known breach lists

rows.name: Disable Browser Sign-in
rows.full: Prevents signing in to the browser itself with an account.
rows.short: Prevents signing in to the browser itself with an account.

rows.name: Enable Global Privacy Control
rows.full: Sends the GPC signal with every request, telling sites not to sell or share your data. Legally binding in some regions (e.g. under CCPA).
rows.short: Sends the GPC signal with every request, telling sites not to sell or share your data

rows.name: Enable De-AMP
rows.full: Skips Google AMP pages and loads the publisher's original page instead.
rows.short: Skips Google AMP pages and loads the publisher's original page instead.

rows.name: Enable Debouncing
rows.full: Skips known tracking redirects and navigates straight to the final destination URL.
rows.short: Skips known tracking redirects and navigates straight to the final destination URL.

rows.name: Strip Tracking URL Parameters
rows.full: Removes known tracking parameters (fbclid, gclid, mc_eid, ...) from URLs before they load.
rows.short: Removes known tracking parameters (fbclid, gclid, mc_eid, ...) from URLs before they load.

rows.name: Reduce Language Fingerprinting
rows.full: Reports a generic language configuration to sites, making your browser harder to fingerprint.
rows.short: Reports a generic language configuration to sites, making your browser harder to fingerprint.

rows.name: Disable WebRTC IP Leak
rows.full: Restricts WebRTC to proxied connections so video/voice calls can't expose your real IP address behind a VPN or proxy.
rows.short: Restricts WebRTC to proxied connections so video/voice calls can't expose your real IP address behind a VPN or proxy.

rows.name: Disable QUIC Protocol
rows.full: Disables the QUIC (HTTP/3) transport so all traffic uses TCP. Useful when a firewall or filter can't inspect QUIC; may slightly slow some Google sites.
rows.short: Disables the QUIC (HTTP/3) transport so all traffic uses TCP

rows.name: Disable Network Prediction (Prefetch)
rows.full: Stops Brave from pre-resolving DNS and pre-connecting to links it guesses you might click, so no network requests are made for pages you never visit.
rows.short: Stops Brave from pre-resolving DNS and pre-connecting to links it guesses you might click, so no network requests are made for pages you never visit.

rows.name: Block Third Party Cookies
rows.full: Blocks cookies set by domains other than the site you are visiting. Can break some embedded logins.
rows.short: Blocks cookies set by domains other than the site you are visiting

rows.name: Block Payment Method Probing
rows.full: Stops sites from querying whether you have payment methods saved (canMakePayment) - they are always told none are available.
rows.short: Stops sites from querying whether you have payment methods saved (canMakePayment) - they are always told none are available.

rows.name: Disable Alternate Error Pages
rows.full: Uses plain local error pages for navigation errors instead of a web-service-assisted suggestion page. Belt-and-braces: Brave already ships this off.
rows.short: Uses plain local error pages for navigation errors instead of a web-service-assisted suggestion page

rows.name: Block Remote Debugging
rows.full: Blocks the remote debugging port and pipe, the interface automation tools use to drive the browser and read your cookies and logged-in sessions. Disable Developer Tools does not cover this. Breaks Puppeteer, Playwright and brave://inspect.
rows.short: Blocks the remote debugging port and pipe, the interface automation tools use to drive the browser and read your cookies and logged-in sessions

rows.name: Disable DNS Interception Probes
rows.full: Stops Brave from resolving three random hostnames at startup and again on every network change to detect a hijacking DNS provider. Those lookups are visible to your ISP or DoH resolver and mark each launch.
rows.short: Stops Brave from resolving three random hostnames at startup and again on every network change to detect a hijacking DNS provider

rows.name: Require HTTPS for Basic Auth
rows.full: Refuses HTTP Basic authentication over plain HTTP so your username and password are never sent in the clear. Breaks logins on legacy routers, printers and other appliances that only serve HTTP.
rows.short: Refuses HTTP Basic authentication over plain HTTP so your username and password are never sent in the clear

rows.name: Web Notifications
rows.full: Sets the default for desktop notifications. Block stops every site from asking or showing them, Ask keeps the permission prompt, Allow grants it to every site.
rows.short: Sets the default for desktop notifications

rows.name: Location Access
rows.full: Sets the default for reading your physical location. Block removes the prompt entirely, so maps and delivery sites will need the location typed manually; Ask keeps the prompt.
rows.short: Sets the default for reading your physical location

rows.name: Motion Sensors
rows.full: Sets the default for motion and orientation sensors, a known fingerprinting vector. Blocking rarely breaks anything on desktop.
rows.short: Sets the default for motion and orientation sensors, a known fingerprinting vector

rows.name: WebUSB Access
rows.full: Sets the default for sites talking to USB devices. Block removes the prompt and breaks web-based hardware wallets (Ledger, Trezor) and in-browser firmware flashers; Ask keeps the prompt. Chromium has no Allow state for this key.
rows.short: Sets the default for sites talking to USB devices

rows.name: Web Serial Access
rows.full: Sets the default for sites opening serial ports. Block removes the prompt and breaks in-browser microcontroller and device programming tools; Ask keeps the prompt. Chromium has no Allow state for this key.
rows.short: Sets the default for sites opening serial ports

rows.name: WebHID Access
rows.full: Sets the default for sites talking to human interface devices. Block removes the prompt and may break security keys and gamepad configurators that use WebHID rather than WebAuthn. Chromium has no Allow state for this key.
rows.short: Sets the default for sites talking to human interface devices

rows.name: Local Font Enumeration
rows.full: Sets the default for sites asking which fonts are installed on your machine - a strong fingerprinting signal that Shields' font protections don't cover. Blocking rarely breaks anything outside web design tools. Chromium has no Allow state for this key.
rows.short: Sets the default for sites asking which fonts are installed on your machine - a strong fingerprinting signal that Shields' font protections don't cover

rows.name: Multi-Screen Access
rows.full: Sets the default for sites reading your monitor layout and placing windows on a chosen screen. Blocking breaks the full-screen presentation mode in some web apps. Chromium has no Allow state for this key.
rows.short: Sets the default for sites reading your monitor layout and placing windows on a chosen screen

rows.name: Force Google SafeSearch
rows.full: Forces SafeSearch on for all Google searches. Mainly useful for parental controls.
rows.short: Forces SafeSearch on for all Google searches

rows.name: Filter Adult Content (SafeSites)
rows.full: Sends every URL you navigate to - including URLs loaded inside frames - to Google's Safe Search API to be classified, and blocks anything rated adult. This is a remote lookup, not a local filter. Mainly useful for parental controls.
rows.short: Sends every URL you navigate to - including URLs loaded inside frames - to Google's Safe Search API to be classified, and blocks anything rated adult

rows.name: Disable Guest Mode
rows.full: Removes guest browsing sessions. Closes the loophole where a guest window bypasses profile-level restrictions and history.
rows.short: Removes guest browsing sessions

rows.name: Block All Extensions
rows.full: Blocks installation of every extension and disables ones already installed. For lockdown/parental setups - a proxy or VPN extension would bypass DNS filtering.
rows.short: Blocks installation of every extension and disables ones already installed

rows.name: Block Sideloaded (External) Extensions
rows.full: Blocks extensions that other programs install for you through the registry or a drop-in file, which is how bundleware gets in. Extensions you install yourself keep working, so this rarely breaks anything.
rows.short: Blocks extensions that other programs install for you through the registry or a drop-in file, which is how bundleware gets in

rows.name: Disable Incognito Mode
rows.full: Removes private browsing entirely - no incognito windows can be opened. Mutually exclusive with Force Incognito Mode.
rows.short: Removes private browsing entirely - no incognito windows can be opened

rows.name: Force Incognito Mode
rows.full: Every window opens in incognito: no history, and logins and most extensions stop persisting. Mutually exclusive with Disable Incognito Mode.
rows.short: Every window opens in incognito: no history, and logins and most extensions stop persisting

rows.name: Disable Brave Rewards
rows.full: Removes Brave Rewards and BAT ads from the browser UI.
rows.short: Removes Brave Rewards and BAT ads from the browser UI.

rows.name: Disable Brave Wallet
rows.full: Disables the built-in cryptocurrency wallet and hides its UI.
rows.short: Disables the built-in cryptocurrency wallet and hides its UI.

rows.name: Disable Brave VPN (no effect on Linux builds)
Disable Brave AI Chat
rows.full: Disables Leo, Brave's built-in AI assistant, and removes it from the sidebar and address bar.
rows.short: Disables Leo, Brave's built-in AI assistant, and removes it from the sidebar and address bar.

rows.name: Disable Local AI (On-Device Models, Brave 1.94+)
rows.full: Stops Brave from downloading and running on-device AI models and from building an AI index of your browsing history. Separate from Brave AI Chat - disabling Leo does not cover this. Needs Brave 1.94 or newer - that is current stable, so most installs already have it; older versions ignore the key. Takes effect after a browser restart.
rows.short: Stops Brave from downloading and running on-device AI models and from building an AI index of your browsing history

rows.name: Disable Brave Shields
rows.full: Turns Shields OFF for every site: no ad blocking, no tracker blocking. Also makes Enforce Ad Blocking, Enforce Fingerprinting Protection, Force HTTPS Upgrades and Cap Referrers do nothing, because Brave skips all four wherever Shields are off. Almost nobody wants this - it exists for kiosk/testing setups. Mutually exclusive with Force Shields On.
rows.short: Turns Shields OFF for every site: no ad blocking, no tracker blocking

rows.name: Force Shields On (All Sites)
rows.full: Locks Shields ON for every site; the per-site Shields toggle stops working. Mutually exclusive with Disable Brave Shields.
rows.short: Locks Shields ON for every site; the per-site Shields toggle stops working

rows.name: Disable Brave News
rows.full: Removes the Brave News feed from the new tab page.
rows.short: Removes the Brave News feed from the new tab page.

rows.name: Disable Brave Talk
rows.full: Disables Brave Talk video calls.
rows.short: Disables Brave Talk video calls.

rows.name: Disable Brave Playlist
rows.full: Disables the Playlist feature for saving and playing media in the sidebar.
rows.short: Disables the Playlist feature for saving and playing media in the sidebar.

rows.name: Disable Web Discovery
rows.full: Stops Brave from anonymously contributing pages you visit to the Brave Search index (Web Discovery Project).
rows.short: Stops Brave from anonymously contributing pages you visit to the Brave Search index (Web Discovery Project).

rows.name: Disable Speedreader
rows.full: Disables Speedreader, the distraction-free article reading mode.
rows.short: Disables Speedreader, the distraction-free article reading mode.

rows.name: Disable Tor
rows.full: Removes the 'New private window with Tor' option.
rows.short: Removes the 'New private window with Tor' option.

rows.name: Disable Sync
rows.full: Disables Brave Sync, which shares bookmarks, history, and settings across devices via a sync chain.
rows.short: Disables Brave Sync, which shares bookmarks, history, and settings across devices via a sync chain.

rows.name: Disable Email Aliases
rows.full: Disables the Email Aliases feature for generating throwaway email addresses.
rows.short: Disables the Email Aliases feature for generating throwaway email addresses.

rows.name: Enforce Ad Blocking
rows.full: Pins Brave's ad and tracker blocking on as managed policy, so it can't be lowered in settings or per-site.
rows.short: Pins Brave's ad and tracker blocking on as managed policy, so it can't be lowered in settings or per-site.

rows.name: Enforce Fingerprinting Protection
rows.full: Pins Shields fingerprinting protection on as managed policy, so sites can't be exempted from it.
rows.short: Pins Shields fingerprinting protection on as managed policy, so sites can't be exempted from it.

rows.name: Force HTTPS Upgrades (Strict)
rows.full: Always upgrades connections to HTTPS. Sites that can't serve HTTPS show a warning page instead of silently falling back to HTTP.
rows.short: Always upgrades connections to HTTPS

rows.name: Cap Referrers (Strict Origin)
rows.full: Caps the Referer header at the origin for cross-site requests, locked as managed policy. Mutually exclusive with Allow Permissive Referrers.
rows.short: Caps the Referer header at the origin for cross-site requests, locked as managed policy

rows.name: Allow Permissive Referrers (unsafe-url)
rows.full: Sends your full referring URL cross-origin when a site requests it. Compatibility escape hatch only - this weakens privacy and is excluded from every preset. Mutually exclusive with Cap Referrers.
rows.short: Sends your full referring URL cross-origin when a site requests it

rows.name: Forget First-Party Storage on Close
rows.full: Clears a site's cookies and storage when you close its last tab - sites forget you (and your logins) between visits.
rows.short: Clears a site's cookies and storage when you close its last tab - sites forget you (and your logins) between visits.

rows.name: Disable Background Mode
rows.full: Stops Brave from keeping background processes running after the last window is closed.
rows.short: Stops Brave from keeping background processes running after the last window is closed.

rows.name: Enable Memory Saver
rows.full: Forces Memory Saver on: inactive tabs are discarded to free RAM and reload when you return to them.
rows.short: Forces Memory Saver on: inactive tabs are discarded to free RAM and reload when you return to them.

rows.name: Force Hardware Acceleration
rows.full: Pins GPU hardware acceleration on so rendering and video decode stay off the CPU. Takes effect after a browser restart.
rows.short: Pins GPU hardware acceleration on so rendering and video decode stay off the CPU

rows.name: Disable Media Router (Cast)
rows.full: Disables the Google Cast media router and its background device discovery on the local network. Takes effect after a browser restart.
rows.short: Disables the Google Cast media router and its background device discovery on the local network

rows.name: Disable Media Recommendations
rows.full: Disables the media history and recommendation surfaces built from what you watch.
rows.short: Disables the media history and recommendation surfaces built from what you watch.

rows.name: Disable Shopping List
rows.full: Disables the price-tracking shopping list feature.
rows.short: Disables the price-tracking shopping list feature.

rows.name: Always Open PDF Externally
rows.full: Downloads PDF files and opens them in your system PDF viewer instead of the built-in viewer.
rows.short: Downloads PDF files and opens them in your system PDF viewer instead of the built-in viewer.

rows.name: Disable Translate
rows.full: Disables the built-in page translation feature and its popup prompts.
rows.short: Disables the built-in page translation feature and its popup prompts.

rows.name: Disable Spellcheck
rows.full: Turns off spell checking in text fields entirely. Mutually exclusive with Disable Enhanced Spell Check, which keeps offline checking and only removes the Google lookup.
rows.short: Turns off spell checking in text fields entirely

rows.name: Disable Search Suggestions
rows.full: Stops sending what you type in the address bar to your search engine for live suggestions.
rows.short: Stops sending what you type in the address bar to your search engine for live suggestions.

rows.name: Disable Printing
rows.full: Disables printing from the browser entirely (including Ctrl+P).
rows.short: Disables printing from the browser entirely (including Ctrl+P).

rows.name: Disable Default Browser Prompt
rows.full: Stops Brave from asking to become your default browser.
rows.short: Stops Brave from asking to become your default browser.

rows.name: Disable Developer Tools
rows.full: Blocks DevTools (F12) and extension debugging everywhere. Don't enable this if you do web development.
rows.short: Blocks DevTools (F12) and extension debugging everywhere

rows.name: Disable Wayback Machine
rows.full: Stops Brave from offering an archive.org snapshot when a page returns 404.
rows.short: Stops Brave from offering an archive.org snapshot when a page returns 404.

presets.name: Maximum Privacy
presets.blurb: Everything privacy-related, at the cost of convenience.

presets.name: Balanced Privacy
presets.blurb: Strong privacy that keeps the conveniences most people want.

presets.name: Performance Focused
presets.blurb: Speed and clutter, not privacy extremes.

presets.name: Developer
presets.blurb: Telemetry off, dev tools and the network stack untouched.

presets.name: Strict Parental Controls
presets.blurb: Lockdown: filtered, no incognito, no extensions.

presets.name: Brave Origin
presets.blurb: Clones Brave Origin's enforced policy set.
